generate_ngrams: generate ngrams of a specified length from a list of string tokens
generate_ngrams_range: generate ngrams across a range of lengths from a list of tokens
tokenize: tokenize a sentence into a list of lowercase tokens with configurable keep and remove lists
VocabDict_word2idx: build a VocabDict from a vocab file and convert words to their integer indices
BeamSearch_decode: run beam search decoding on model scores to generate caption sequences from image features
